title: Patient Statement, Collections and Balance Relief Schedule — Insured Plan of Care
content:
**Patient Accounts Manual — Insured Plan of Care, statement and balance terms by payer program.**

| Payer program | Statement cycle (calendar days) | Statement that is the final notice | Small-balance write-off allowed | Small-balance write-off maximum | Booking hold balance threshold | Patient Hardship Discount Program adjustments | Patient Payment Plan transfers |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Plan of Care | 30 | 3rd | Yes | $9.99 | $250.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Commercial High-Deductible Plan of Care | 30 | 3rd | Yes | $9.99 | $250.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Commercial POS Plan of Care | 30 | 3rd | Yes | $9.99 | $250.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Commercial HMO Plan of Care | 30 | 3rd | Yes | $9.99 | $250.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Medicare Part B Plan of Care | 30 | 4th | No | $0.00 | $250.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Medicare Advantage Plan of Care | 30 | 3rd | No | $0.00 | $250.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan of Care | 30 | 3rd | No | $0.00 | $0.00 | No | No |

## Definitions

1. **Statement cycle** — the calendar days between consecutive patient statements on an open balance.
2. **Statements before collections** — the number of statements issued on an unpaid balance, the last of which is the final notice (3 statements on every program except the Medicare Part B Plan of Care, which issues 4).
3. **Small-balance write-off allowed / maximum** — whether an open balance at or below the maximum may be written off after the final statement, and the largest balance that may be written off as a small balance ($0.00 where no small-balance write-off is allowed).
4. **Booking hold balance threshold** — the open patient balance on the plan, more than 60 days past its posting date, at or above which new appointment series may not be booked until the balance is paid or placed on a payment plan; $0.00 means the hold never applies.
5. **Hardship adjustments** — whether patient balances on the plan may receive a Patient Hardship Discount Program adjustment.
6. **Payment plan transfers** — whether patient balances on the plan may be moved into a Patient Payment Plan.

## Illustration (hypothetical balances)

- A hypothetical open balance of $9.99 on a commercial program is at the small-balance maximum; a balance of $10.00 is above it.
- A hypothetical balance of $250.00 that has been open more than 60 days past its posting date on the Commercial PPO Plan of Care is at the booking hold threshold; on the Medicaid Managed Care Plan of Care the threshold shows $0.00, so the hold never applies there.
